title: Virtual Assistant for Daily Job Submissions
description: Job Description: Virtual Assistant — Remote Job Application Submissions We are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help us submit applications on remote job platforms on a daily basis. This is an ongoing opportunity with consistent weekly workload for the right candidate. Responsibilities Submit 70–90 job applications per day on remote job boards Follow provided guidelines and templates accurately Maintain quality and consistency across every submission Report daily progress with proof of submissions Requirements Strong written and spoken English communication skills Reliable internet connection and computer access Ability to work consistently and meet daily submission targets Attention to detail and strong work ethic Honest, trustworthy, and dependable Compensation $0.06 – $0.08 per successful job submission Payment released weekly as milestones through Freelancer.com Note: We do not pay through crypto or any payment method outside of Freelancer.com Training A short training session will be provided before you begin, so you are fully clear on the process and expectations. Who We’re Looking For We want a hard worker who takes pride in reliability and consistency. If you are honest, committed, and can deliver quality work every day, we would love to hear from you. To Apply Please share: Your experience with similar VA or data entry work The hours per day you can commit Confirmation that you accept weekly milestone payment through Freelancer.com Important — To Filter Out Automated Replies: Please answer this question in your proposal: “What is the current website where I posted this job and you are applying from?” Any proposal that does not answer this question will be ignored. Serious applicants only. Thank you!
